    Cyclic images of restricted representables #

    This file extracts the finite-length radical induction used for stable representables into a form valid for an arbitrary finite functor. The target-specific input is only a natural map from one indecomposable representable; its image has that representable as a minimal projective cover, and the image of the representable radical is its categorical radical.
